$Comment: The Turkey Souls the Turkey Graveyard's fights raise (the role Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul, and Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_HM on the hard way in): the waves around the fountain, which the Great Turkey waits on until none is left alive, and the souls that join it mid-fight. Each fight clears every one of them when it resets, so the next try starts clean. No reputation names this group, and Martha's favor counts none of it: a Turkey Soul is a spirit, not a turkey. Add a role id here if a fight raises another kind.
